case_summary.critical_risk_criterion: Authorised AI assessment contributions, accountable human group responsibility and protection of group personal information.
case_summary.critical_gap_explanation: While N002 s.2.8.1 and N136/N133 govern human group responsibility and GenAI permission, no operative policy governs persistent AI agents joining student group workspaces with cross-session memory or protects group personal information in student-managed digital workspaces.
case_summary.case_note: Curtin requires group contribution declarations (N002 s.2.8.1), GenAI permission and disclosure (N133, N136), and privacy/security compliance (N001, N017). However, no operative rule governs persistent AI agents joining student group workspaces with cross-session memory or protects group personal information in student-selected workspaces (D5=2, Critical gap=Yes). Protocol v1.1 was adopted after preliminary review on 2026-11-15.
